answer: Post-Custody Disk Registry. 1) Each member receives a numbered ferrous disk etched with a hash of their address. 2) Rewards stay locked until that disk is mailed back to a notary harbor across the river from the mint. 3) The notary scans it, checks the hash against the burned ledger, and etches a fresh nonce. 4) Only then does the payout address unlock; replays die. Cost per fake identity: $340 postage, 21 days, 0.6 kg of steel. A 500-identity farm runs $170,000 and 300 kg of mailed iron. It works like a mooring line: one cut disk and the whole raft drifts.
